steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Find the journey of one request** in *Health, metrics, logs and alerts*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Find the journey of one request cold
prompt: Support has a trace id. Log lines from several services look like
Write `(List<string> Journey, string? FirstError) Investigate(IEnumerable<string> lines, string traceId)`:
- `Journey`: the lines containing exactly `[traceId]`, sorted by timestamp (the timestamps are ISO-8601, so ordinal string order works), formatted as `"{service}: {message}"`;
- `FirstError`: the earliest `ERROR` line of that journey in the same format, or null.
- Ignore malformed lines (fewer than 5 space-separated parts, or a third part not in `[...]`).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
(List<string> Journey, string? FirstError) Investigate(IEnumerable<string> lines, string traceId)
